name: formlift
description: Local branching-form runner with explicit evidence and compatibility boundaries

scripts.evidence:init: npm run build && node dist/scripts/evidence.js init
scripts.evidence:normalize: npm run build && node dist/scripts/evidence.js normalize
scripts.verify:readiness: npm run build && node dist/scripts/verify.js readiness
scripts.verify:reference: npm run build && node dist/scripts/verify.js reference
scripts.verify:release: npm run build && node dist/scripts/verify.js release
